Bradford Libraries

Bradford Libraries already stock a range of books on Palestine.

Book Search

To search the Bradford Library catalogue and reserve a book see the Library Search Page.

Purchase Request

To request a new book purchase, complete the Libries Stock Suggestion Form. If you want to make a second purchase request you need to use a different browser, a private browsing window, or change devices.

Books

Books available in Bradford Libraries include

  • Shindler, Colin - Palestine: a short history by
  • Khalidi, Rashid - A Forever War: Israel and Palestine by
  • Cohn-Sherbok, Dan - The Palestine-Israeli conflict: a beginner’s guide
  • Hammad, Isabell - Enter Ghost (Fiction)
  • Shehadeh, Raja - Occupation diaries
